project_info.brief_explanation: A simple Python CLI application to record expenses into a SQLite database.

sections.title: Feature Specification: Expense Tracker CLI
sections.raw_content:
**Feature Branch**: `feature/001-expense-tracker-cli`

**Created**: 2026-07-24

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "Crée une spécification initiale très simple dans .specify/specs/expense_tracker_spec.md pour une application CLI de gestion de dépenses (Expense Tracker) en Python. Respecte la Constitution du projet : Langage : Python 3.10+, Base de données : SQLite, Interface : CLI basique. Contenu souhaité : 1. Titre et résumé exécutif court. 2. Une User Story basique : Permettre à l'utilisateur d'ajouter une dépense avec un montant et une description via la CLI. 3. Un modèle de données minimal (table SQLite `expenses`)."

sections.title: User Story 1 - Record a New Expense (Priority: P1)
sections.raw_content:
As a user, I want to record a spending event by providing a description and an amount via the command line so that I can track my expenses.

**Why this priority**: This is the core functionality of the application. Without the ability to add expenses, the tracker serves no purpose.

**Independent Test**: Execute a command to add an expense (e.g., `add "Lunch" 15.50`) and verify that the data is persisted in the database and a confirmation is shown.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the application is running, **When** I provide a valid description (non-empty string) and a positive numeric amount, **Then** the expense is saved to the database and a success message is displayed.
2. **Given** the application is running, **When** I provide a non-numeric amount, **Then** an error message is displayed explaining the input is invalid, and no record is created.
3. **Given** the application is running, **When** I provide an empty description, **Then** an error message is displayed and no record is created.

---

sections.title: Edge Cases
sections.raw_content:
- **Negative Amounts**: The system should treat negative amounts as invalid inputs unless explicitly defined as "income" (out of scope for this initial spec).
- **Zero Amount**: Expenses of 0.00 should be accepted if the description is valid.
- **Large Numbers**: Ensure the system handles large numeric values without precision loss (using appropriate numeric types).
- **Special Characters**: Descriptions containing quotes or special characters should be handled without crashing the CLI.

sections.title: Functional Requirements
sections.raw_content:
- **FR-001**: System MUST allow users to add a new expense by providing a description and an amount via the CLI.
- **FR-002**: System MUST persist every successfully added expense in a SQLite database.
- **FR-003**: System MUST validate that the amount is a valid positive number.
- **FR-004**: System MUST validate that the description is not empty.
- **FR-005**: System MUST provide immediate visual confirmation (success or error) to the user after an attempt to add an expense.

sections.title: Key Entities *(include if feature involves data)*
sections.raw_content:
- **Expense**: Represents a single financial expenditure.
  - `id`: Unique identifier (Primary Key).
  - `description`: A brief text description of the expense.
  - `amount`: The numeric cost of the expense.
  - `created_at`: Timestamp of when the expense was recorded.

sections.title: Measurable Outcomes
sections.raw_content:
- **SC-001**: Users can successfully add a valid expense in under 10 seconds from command execution to confirmation.
- **SC-002**: 100% of validated and "successfully added" expenses are retrievable from the SQLite database.
- **SC-003**: 100% of invalid inputs (e.g., text in amount field) result in a user-facing error message rather than a system crash.

sections.title: Assumptions
sections.raw_content:
- **Environment**: The user has Python 3.10+ installed and is running the application in a standard terminal/shell.
- **Persistence**: The SQLite database file is automatically created in the project root or a designated data folder on first execution.
- **Scope**: Only "adding" expenses is covered in this initial specification; listing, deleting, or summarizing expenses is out of scope for this version.
- **Data Types**: Amounts are handled as decimals to ensure financial precision.
